scripts.build: npm run build -w @someonewithpc/paper && npm run build -w @someonewithpc/paper-react
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && svelte-check --tsconfig ./packages/paper/tsconfig.svelte.json --threshold warning && npm run check:astro
scripts.check:astro: node scripts/link-self.mjs playground/astro && astro check --root playground/astro
scripts.site:dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w site
scripts.site:build: npm run build && npm run build -w site
scripts.site:deploy: npm run site:build && npm run deploy -w site
